chars.STEPMOM: a Moroccan woman in her early 30s with long wavy dark hair tied back, wearing a bright mustard-yellow house kaftan with white embroidery and gold hoop earrings
chars.BOY: a 12-year-old Moroccan boy with short curly black hair, wearing a red hoodie with a white stripe across the chest and blue jeans
chars.DAD: a Moroccan man in his late 40s with a short grey beard and receding hair, wearing a dark green work jacket over a beige shirt
chars.AUNTS: two Moroccan women in their 30s, one in a pink kaftan, one in a lilac kaftan with a patterned headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan family kitchen-dining room, STEPMOM smiling sweetly and placing a plate of tagine in front of BOY at the table, seen from the doorway, head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, warm light, exaggerated caring gesture

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: STEPMOM at the house door handing BOY a lunchbox wrapped in cloth and fixing his hoodie collar like a loving mother, BOY with school backpack looking surprised and pleased, Moroccan apartment entrance

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: STEPMOM sitting beside BOY at a small table in a Moroccan living room, pointing at his school notebook and explaining patiently, BOY listening, cosy evening lamp light

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: DAD standing in the living room doorway with arms crossed, smiling proudly as he watches STEPMOM hug BOY on the sofa; STEPMOM glances sideways toward DAD to check he is watching, slightly theatrical smile

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: BOY sitting alone on a bed in a small bare bedroom, looking sad and lonely; through the open door in the background STEPMOM walks past in the hallway without looking at him, cold expression, phone in hand

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Busy Moroccan kitchen full of steam and pots, STEPMOM and AUNTS cooking together and laughing loudly; BOY in the foreground at the kitchen doorway with his school backpack, confused, nobody notices him

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon with colourful sedari sofas, STEPMOM dancing joyfully with a scarf tied around her hips while AUNTS clap and play a bendir drum, a speaker on the table, party mood; BOY standing at the edge of the room staring, shocked

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Evening at the apartment entrance, DAD just arrived from work taking off his jacket, BOY tugging his sleeve and talking urgently, worried face, DAD tired

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: DAD waving his hand dismissively at BOY with an impatient face, BOY looking frustrated and hurt; in the background STEPMOM in the kitchen doorway with a quiet satisfied smirk
